title: The Lion Warms Up the Stage
skyStory: The full moon roars into Leo at ninety-eight percent, golden and theatrical, sweeping its silver cape across a sky full of snow clouds. Leo loves an audience and a spotlight, and tonight the moon is both. It practices its bows. Mars applauds from the front row. Saturn, in the back, clapping politely, is secretly moved. Tomorrow is the big show.

reading: Fire signs love a Leo moon, and you will feel it in your chest like a drumroll. Today you get the spotlight, maybe in a meeting, maybe at dinner, maybe just in your own kitchen. Take it. Speak up. Tell the story fully.

But [[The Sun]] is reversed for you two, a gentle reminder that joy should be allowed, not earned. So when the applause comes, do not deflect it with a joke. Take the bow. The Tiger and the Lion are cousins, and cousins know how to soak up a little glory.
joel.mission: When someone praises your work today, take a real bow, literally, from the waist.
joel.omen: A golden light in a window at dusk. It means the spotlight is yours tonight.
joel.elementWhy: the Lion and the Tiger roar

reading: Leo moons make storytellers glow, and you are a storyteller to the bone. Tonight someone will ask you to tell a story you have told before. Tell it bigger. Add a dramatic pause. Let your hands do a full performance.

The audience will be small, maybe one person, maybe the cat, but it will be the best version of that story ever told. Saturn, your ruler, quietly approves of a well-rehearsed classic. Then, tomorrow night, get ready for something special. The full moon is setting the stage just for you two.
nancy.mission: Retell your favourite story tonight with at least one dramatic pause and one big hand flourish.
nancy.omen: A lion on a sign, a flag or a statue. It means your voice carries further than you think.

together.text: Tomorrow is the Full Moon Recharge. Tonight, find a spot near a window where the moonlight will fall, and clear it like a stage. Tell each other where your spot is. The ruby and the onyx have a date with the sky.

game.intro: Full moon in Leo and the lion is warming up backstage. The crew wants to hear every scale.
game.prompt: A lion doing vocal warm-ups backstage before its big show.
